values.note: Suffolk County's online reservation system (reserveparks.suffolkcountyny.gov, which forwards to the county's WebTrac site) needs a Green Key login. Non-residents buy either the $50 Non-Resident Reservation Green Key (1 year, non-resident rates, and a camping reservation made with it must be at least FOUR nights) or the $200 Non-Resident VIP Green Key (1 year, resident rates).

booking.source: https://www.suffolkcountyny.gov/Departments/Parks/Our-Parks/Indian-Island-County-Park (Reservations link -> https://www.reserveparks.suffolkcountyny.gov/, which 303-redirects to nysuffolkctyweb.myvscloud.com/webtrac/web/) + https://suffolkcountyny.gov/Departments/Parks/Green-Key-Card ('The Green Key card is also required to access the online reservation system for camping'; 'Non-Resident Reservation Green Key: This $50 Green Key allows the user to access our online reservation system for Camping ... Good for 1 year ... Applies Non-Resident rates for all purchases. When making a camping reservation, it requires the user to make a MINIMUM FOUR NIGHTS stay.'; 'The $200 Non-Resident VIP Green Key allows non-residents access our online reservation system for Camping and Golf at resident rates'), read 2026-10-21

facilities.source: https://www.suffolkcountyny.gov/Departments/Parks/Our-Parks/Indian-Island-County-Park ('Restrooms and shower facilities are available for the comfort of all campers.'), read 2026-10-21

note: Suffolk County park at the Peconic River/Flanders Bay. ~100-150 tent & trailer sites, some electric; some water-view sites. --Claude  Verified 2026-09-14: the non-resident Green Key is $50 and valid one year, and without it the county reservation system cannot be used at all; non-resident camping rates are exactly double resident. --Claude
summary: County pages confirm reservable online (Green Key required), showers, phone 631-852-3232; the March 2026 fee schedule confirms the county row's resident $18 in season / $9 off season, non-resident $36 / $18 (double), electric and sewer +$8, weekend +$4, $10 reservation + $3 registration. NEW: a camping reservation made with the $50 Non-Resident Reservation Green Key must be at least four nights (the $200 VIP key books at resident rates; no minimum stated for it). Note trimmed of field facts. Not stated for Indian Island itself: site count, which sites are Premier/Tier I/II, hookups, dump, season.
flags: Criteria/minimum-stay: Suffolk County's Green Key page says a camping reservation made with the $50 Non-Resident Reservation Green Key 'requires the user to make a MINIMUM FOUR NIGHTS stay' - a standing 4-night minimum for non-residents (a non-resident avoids it only with the $200 VIP Green Key). Recorded in booking.note because min_stay cannot say 'non-residents only'; the local:suffolk-county-ny row should carry it too.
